-- ============================================================
-- OPTIMIZED: Single query with CTE (v4.0)
-- Объединяет 4 запроса в 1 для эффективности
-- ============================================================

WITH upserted_session AS (
  INSERT INTO candidate_sessions (
    telegram_user_id,
    first_name,
    status,
    started_at,
    language
  ) VALUES ($1, $2, 'in_progress', NOW(), 'ru')
  ON CONFLICT (telegram_user_id) 
  DO UPDATE SET 
    status = CASE 
      WHEN candidate_sessions.status = 'completed' THEN 'in_progress'
      ELSE candidate_sessions.status 
    END,
    first_name = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.first_name, candidate_sessions.first_name)
  RETURNING id, telegram_user_id, status, language, first_name
),
active_vacancies AS (
  SELECT 
    json_agg(json_build_object(
      'id', id,
      'position_name', position_name,
      'pain_points', pain_points,
      'benefits', benefits,
      'salary_min', salary_min,
      'salary_max', salary_max,
      'minimum_score', minimum_score
    )) as vacancies
  FROM vacancies 
  WHERE status = 'active'
  LIMIT 10
),
chat_history AS (
  SELECT 
    json_agg(json_build_object(
      'user_message', user_message,
      'bot_response', bot_response,
      'extracted_data', extracted_data,
      'created_at', created_at
    ) ORDER BY created_at DESC) as history
  FROM n8n_chat_histories
  WHERE session_id = (SELECT id FROM upserted_session)
  LIMIT 15
)
SELECT 
  us.id as session_id,
  us.telegram_user_id,
  us.status as session_status,
  us.language,
  us.first_name as session_first_name,
  COALESCE(av.vacancies, '[]'::json) as vacancies,
  COALESCE(ch.history, '[]'::json) as chat_history
FROM upserted_session us
CROSS JOIN active_vacancies av
CROSS JOIN chat_history ch;
